note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 27; A06b Const 27; L05 C1999 28.1): ordinary naturalisation after 15 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Nigeria, 2024
sources.said: Person has resided in Nigeria for a continuous period of 15 years, or has resided for 1 year prior to application and 15 years over previous 20 years ... Renunciation is required unless applicant is a citizen by birth in the other country. ... Person is not a citizen of Nigeria by birth and  acquires or retains another citizenship of a country of which he is not a citizen by birth.
